projects.el-pollo-loco.description: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
projects.el-pollo-loco.details: Independently developed the entire game, including its object-oriented architecture and core gameplay mechanics. Implemented self-managed game intervals with pause functionality, desktop and mobile controls with touch input, and various enemies, collectibles, and throwable objects. All game elements feature animations, complemented by immersive backgrounds with parallax scrolling, dynamic camera movement, and a fullscreen mode with automatic asset scaling.
projects.el-pollo-loco.title: El Pollo Loco
projects.join.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories. Developed collaboratively by a team of three software developers.
projects.join.details: My role focused on the application's core functionality and user experience, from Supabase authentication and SPA routing to the responsive Kanban board with animated drag-and-drop interactions. I also developed the database service and reusable UI components for dynamic buttons and user icons.

Let's collaborate and build something remarkable together!

testimonial.christian.text: He acted as the company supervisor for my bachelor's thesis. From the very beginning, I appreciated his deep technical knowledge, structured approach, and willingness to support and mentor. After I finished my bachelor's degree, we worked closely together as colleagues. In this phase, I experienced firsthand his outstanding capabilities as an embedded systems software developer. Following his promotion to Software Development Manager, he continued to excel, demonstrating strong leadership, clear communication, and sound technical judgment. In my view, his performance as both a developer and a manager is truly outstanding.
testimonial.christian.title: Software developer embedded systems
testimonial.eva.text: Sven has built and led international teams, communicates clearly in remote settings, and still stays hands-on with production code. He's a thoughtful leader, a strong problem solver, and someone I'd confidently recommend for senior engineering or leadership roles in remote-first teams.

testimonial.wanja.text: I had the pleasure of working with Sven on a complex front-end project, and I learned an enormous amount from him in the process. His performance and guidance were a key reason we were able to complete the project so successfully. I thoroughly enjoyed working with him, both professionally and personally.
